title: UPSSSC Auditor/ Assistant Accountant Online Form 2026
intro: Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Auditor/ Assistant Accountant on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 1829 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Auditor/ Assistant Accountant Recruitment 2026 will start from 14 July 2026, and candidates can apply until 03 August 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPSSSC Auditor/ Assistant Accountant Recruitment 2026 given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
